'''Knockout drops''' were a type of artificial [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that could render a target unconscious if ingested. They could be put into [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] or drink.<ref name="TUR" />

[[File:Taskee.jpg|thumb|left|135px|Tas Kee carried hidden knockout drops inside the Outlander Club]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Tas Kee]] carried hidden knockout drops on her person while inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AotC:TVD" />

The [[Malkite Poisoners]], a secretive group of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malkii/Legends|Malkii]], made use of knockout drops.<ref name="TotG" />

The [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid|Mark VI Scarab droid]], a diminutive [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and later by the [[Dark Empire]], carried knockout drops among other sinister substances, such as [[Truth serum/Legends|truth serums]], [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinogenic]] drugs, and [[Death/Legends|fatal]] poisons.<ref name="FF98" />
